charts.title: WASP-7 b: orbits around WASP-7
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-7's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-7 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 4.95464865738 d

charts.title: WASP-7 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-7 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (94, 95, 105) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 389352124, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
